pairs.why: Nearly identical stars, but A's slightly wider, chunkier body and softer center gradient sit a touch closer to the soft, puffy volume of the real cards than B's flatter, crisper bevel.
The two stars are practically identical in shape, gold finish, gloss and lighting, so neither reads closer to the real cards.
Same glossy gold star with matching rims and ball tips in both, and no meaningful difference in finish or build.
A's center is a smoother, softer gold glow with gentler rim highlights, closer to the soft-lit real cards than B's harder, more metallic bevel.
B's warmer, softer inner glow and rounder volume read slightly less statue-like than A's crisper, more polished gold.
A's slightly larger, puffier star with a softer center gradient matches the real cards' chunky, pillowy shapes a little better than B.
B's tilted, sharper bevel looks a bit more like a hard metal statue, while A's front-on, softer star is marginally closer to the real cards.
A's thicker, rounder rim and fuller body give the chunkier toy-like build of the real cards, while B is slightly thinner and more polished.
